title: Hole Map Synchronizer
description: Implement a script `lib/wdd/sync.py` that reads the `mailbox/` and automatically updates the markdown table in `docs/HOLEMAP.md`.

requirements.sync: Must accurately reflect OPEN, SEALED, etc. from the JSON envelopes into the markdown.

acceptance_criteria: Running the sync script updates the markdown table accurately.
failure_modes: FAIL: Destroying non-table content in HOLEMAP.md.
